articles.title: Velcro-Finned Fish Defy Gravity, Scaling 50-Foot Waterfall
articles.summary: African shellear fish, under two inches long, use microscopic fin hooks to climb a 15-meter waterfall. A new study reveals their exhausting 10-hour journey, shedding light on this remarkable adaptation.

articles.title: Blade Runner 2099 Trailer Unleashes a Replicant Uprising 50 Years in the Making
articles.summary: The first trailer for Prime Video's Blade Runner 2099 reveals a world where replicants have overthrown humanity. Starring Michelle Yeoh, the series picks up decades after 2049 with a fugitive turned Blade Runner.

articles.title: The Ultimate Surprise: Niall Horan Secretly Duets with Off Campus Star Ella Bright
articles.summary: Ella Bright was kept in the dark about Niall Horan recording vocals for her cover of "Baby Now That I Found You." The reveal, captured on video, shows her stunned reaction to the dream collaboration.
